h: Toke Makinwa celebrates 42nd birthday with praise singer and thanksgiving
p: Media personality Toke Makinwa marked her 42nd birthday by hiring a praise singer and sharing a video of herself dancing in thanksgiving. She said she owed God praise over a personal matter.
body: Media personality Toke Makinwa has marked her 42nd birthday with a joyful thanksgiving celebration.

On Tuesday, 3 November 2026, the former radio presenter shared a video of herself dancing as a praise singer performed songs of worship for her. In her caption, she said she owed God praise over a personal matter and had come to give it, adding that she was trusting God for another matter too. She also posted birthday photos in a white dress and revealed that she almost skipped the photo shoot.

Toke Makinwa is one of Nigeria's best-known media personalities, a former presenter on Rhythm FM and a television host. She is also an author, businesswoman and vlogger, and has spoken openly about her personal life, including her divorce. She is a mother to a young daughter, and recently shared a light-hearted video of herself teasing her during feeding time.
Fans and fellow celebrities flooded her page with birthday wishes and prayers, with many saying her thanksgiving was inspiring and praying that her other request would also be granted.
more: She hired a praise singer for a thanksgiving session.
Fans flooded her page with birthday wishes.
